en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a Spanish Mission–style building with multiple arches, bell niches, and a central tower. Numerous women in long dresses pose around the arches, balconies, and courtyard, suggesting a staged group portrait. The architecture features stucco walls, red-tile roofs, and ornamental bells. Printed captions and publisher information appear along the bottom and the left and right margins.
